observations.body: Signed-out Login displays Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and demo account names including emily.dawson.
Login fields are available for the configured Employee account.
Signing in as the configured Employee reached the employee dashboard.

Employee Dashboard offers navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, and My Profile; it also offers Notifications, Log out, Request leave, and Fill timesheet. It displays pending leave requests as 0 while the leave balance is loading.
Request leave reached New leave request.

New leave request offers a leave-type selector with Vacation selected plus Sick and Personal options, required Start date and End date fields, an optional Reason field, Submit request, and Cancel; it states weekends are not counted toward leave.
Vacation is selected and the empty leave form is ready for one future-weekday evaluation request.
Submitting with both required date fields empty displayed “Please fill in all required fields.” and remained on New leave request; the evaluation reason stayed entered.
Opening Start date displayed a September 2026 calendar with previous and next month controls and dates 1 through 30; the date textbox remained read-only.
Timesheet shows Week of Sep 14, 2026 in draft state with seven day-hour inputs all at 0, Total 0 h, Save draft, and Submit week.
My profile offers photo upload, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled Email field, and Save changes.
